9b4be0c755fd255c.description: Start your career in finance with Morgan Stanley as a Investment Banking Analyst Intern in Thiruvananthapuram. You will sit with a working investment bank team, use the same systems and reports they do, and own a defined piece of work from day one. About the role As a Investment Banking Analyst Intern at Morgan Stanley, your core focus will be financial modelling, valuation and pitch-book preparation for live deals. You will be attached to a named mentor, join the team's daily stand-ups and reviews, and be trusted with work that genuinely matters rather than filing and formatting. Questions are encouraged, mistakes are treated as teaching moments, and your output is reviewed properly so you actually improve. What you'll do day to day Support financial modelling, valuation and pitch-book preparation for live deals alongside the core investment bank team Work in Excel and the company's internal systems on live financial data Prepare schedules, reconciliations and reports that go to real reviewers Research companies, customers, products or regulations as the work demands Turn your analysis into clear notes and decks for senior stakeholders Follow the documentation and control standards a regulated business requires Take part in reviews, ask questions and act on the feedback you receive Skills you'll build You will build practical, demonstrable experience in Financial Modelling, Valuation (DCF & Comparables), MS Excel, PowerPoint / Pitch Books, Company Research, M&A Fundamentals, Accounting Fundamentals, Capital Markets, Analytical Thinking, Business Writing the exact toolkit that separates a hireable finance fresher from a CV full of coursework. No prior work experience is required. Curiosity, numerical comfort and care with detail matter far more here than a polished rsum, and every one of these skills is taught on the job. Who should apply Students in their final year or recent graduates from MBA (Finance)/CFA L1/CA/B.Com (Hons)/BBA based in or willing to work from Thiruvananthapuram. You should be comfortable with numbers, willing to learn Financial Modelling, Valuation (DCF & Comparables), MS Excel, and able to communicate clearly in writing. Relevant coursework, certifications (NISM, CFA L1, GST, Tally) or a strong academic record in Financial Modelling will strengthen your application, but none of them are mandatory. Internship details This is a 3-month internship in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, with a stipend of 43,000 per month. ODK | Senior Product Manager | Remote (Worldwide) | Long-term contract, 30–40 hours/week | $90–$110/hour USD
ODK is an open-source platform used by thousands of organizations worldwide to collect billions of data points for disease surveillance, supply chain traceability, environmental monitoring, and more. It enables users to build powerful forms and reliably collect structured data, even in places with little or no Internet connectivity.
ODK has been actively developed for 18 years. We have a mix of self-hosted and SaaS users across many sectors. We're looking for a senior product manager who will own product discovery and prioritization across this diverse user base. To be successful, you'll need to find the common needs behind very different workflows and turn them into opinionated product improvements.
Because the team is small and the user base is large, this is a high-autonomy role where product decisions have an unusually direct impact. You should have substantial experience managing complex B2B or technical products. Experience with open source, self-hosted software, and small, fully remote teams is a plus.
